positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior backend engineer on Carvana's Corporate Engineering team — we build the internal platforms and automation that our recruiting, onboarding, and HR operations teams run on. I work in C# / .NET 8, GraphQL, and GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini), and build AI developer tooling on top of Claude Code.

Selected work:

• Drove a flagship recruiting-workflow automation to its deadline after two senior engineers rolled off mid-project — ran the research spike, scoped 12 implementation tickets out of the Epic, and shipped every one.

• Built an AI-powered Resume Parser microservice end-to-end in 2 months — .NET 8 Clean Architecture, Google Cloud Vertex AI with Gemini 2.5 Flash, prompt engineering with structured JSON validation, Cosmos DB change feed, Kafka event publishing. Used by our recruiting team to enrich incoming candidate data automatically.

• Authored a multi-agent code-review plugin on Claude Code now run by every engineer on our team on their own PRs.

• Built and still own the internal GraphQL backend powering the new-hire workflow our onboarding team uses every day — from greenfield design through production.

• Built an AI-powered self-review POC at the company hackathon (Claude AI + MCP) that earned leadership support to develop into a production tool; engineering excellence award nominee, 2025.

positions.title: .Net Software Developer
positions.description:
Main techs: ASP.NET MVC, WCF, HTML, JQuery, TypeScript, Ajax, CSS,Bootstrap, Oracle SQL development

•	Developed MVC, WCF, and Oracle code
•	Performed SDLC as a team member
•	Eliminated dependencies of Legacy program
•	Supported production issues and QA team 
•	Developed automated-test project using Katalon Studio

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
•	Built common practice of 5 teams providing centralized open source such as trainings, system docs, SDLC checklist
•	Managed and supoorted 15+ developers through expectation communication to increase team work, time management and product quality
•	Defined SDLC checklist for consistent improvement on all aspects including CI/CD quality and individual growth
•	Supported team members including new hires by training and analyzing problems to provide best decision

positions.title: MES Specialist
positions.description:
MES Systems Management Team at Hyundai Mobis.
Main technologies are C#.NET and SQL Server.

• Updated UI in C#.NET utilizing SDLC concept, then performed version control steps
• Minimized downtime through regular maintenance of database, software and hardware
• Troubleshot DB issues including linked-server, stored procedure, raw-data handling on SQL Server 2005

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned training tool utilizing SharePoint functions to provide structured and all-encompassing platform
• Ranked top 3 teams on interns’ project by combining member’s analysis, communication, and Excel skills
• Recognized as a fast-learner based on proactive attitude: questioning on principles and preparations for meetings

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Reviewed and compiled written general entries for the past year into Quickbooks
• Produced a bilingual accounting training video expecting rapid decrease of errors and potential fraud
• Analyzed and developed project plan that facilitated team members to achieve 120% of initial work plan

positions.title: Student Consultant
positions.description:
• Produced and maintained financial training videos that enhanced each department’s work efficiency and accuracy
• Built business continuity plan webpage for secured document sharing to be used by 23 departments
• Created semi-automated process for closing purchase order that was accepted by supervisor, reduced work time by
40% and inspired fully automated process change

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Trained 10 new officers in teamwork-oriented tasks facilitating and improving teamwork performances
• Created flowcharts on each team that reinforces on-time delivery, output quality and work efficiency

• Directed annual fund raising project; assigning out over 250 opportunities to reach 83% of fund raising limit
• Analyzed cash flow and presented the current year budget reducing by 20% while improving the quality of activities

projects.title: INTEX
projects.description:
1. Analyze the company & its processes
Feasibility justification
Project plan for implementation
2. Appropriate systems analysis
Diagrams (User requirements as systems specifications)
Process modeling
3. Database Design
Data modeling (including conceptual and database create script)
4. Java (Prototype of user interface screens) 
Recommended solution (using SWT)
5. Recommendations for implementing a solution
6. Integrity control
Main Issues / Controls

projects.title: MyStuff
projects.description:
Contents:
A relational database schema (updated and corrected to be consistent with other elements of your proposal)
A recommendation for hardware, network, and platforms
Feasibility and risk analysis 
Estimated development costs and benefits
Overall diagram of the menu hierarchy of user interface design 
Wire frame
Background of the company and overview of the problem
Description of business case
Preliminary list of business benefits
Overview of System  requirements
Preliminary iteration plan (prioritized list of tasks)
Diagrams (organize by subsystems)
Use case description
Use case diagram
Activity diagram
System sequence diagram
